evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

observations.why: Xena reports Quinton's directive that all Meridian deploys must carry a signed manifest — a rank-based requirement imposed on the deployment pipeline.
Quinton enacts authority-ranking by issuing a binding requirement: every Meridian deployment must have a signed manifest before shipping.
Quinton justifies the gate by citing a proportionate consequence — past unsigned artifacts reaching staging are the cost the new gate is designed to prevent.
The summary restates the gate as a requirement — authority-ranking language recording a rank-imposed obligation on Meridian deploys.
Assigning a named owner enacts authority-ranking — rank-based allocation of responsibility for the gate to Quinton Fairweather.
